Sir, Let’s try a few things to attempt to get you started. Each machine is started at the factory prior to shipment to ensure that they are in working order.
These steps are also in the owner’s manual for the tool.
Please try these steps.
1. Fill it with 50:1 premix fuel
2. Pump the primer bubble 10-12 times
3. Place the choke lever in the choke position
4. Pull the recoil starter until you get a choked start
5. Place the choke lever in the run position
6. Pull the recoil starter until you get a full start
Also, You can try to hold and squeeze the throttle trigger at the same time you're pulling the recoil starter. Also, try the choke lever in different positions.

Results.ReviewText: I used the trimmer very few times, and it has some problems which are annoying but tolerable, and one problem which makes the tool dangerous. It is always a struggle to start it initially. Once it finally starts, it is then pretty easy to stop and start it again. Unfortunately, it is necessary to stop and start it several times because the string line head does not work properly. It has two chambers, and one of them runs out of the line much faster than the other. After few minutes of trimming, there is a string coming out of only one hole, not both. This is because one chamber is already empty. So, it takes to stop the trimmer, remove the head and rewind the line. Rewinding is very easy though, this part is designed well. These problems are tolerable, but there is also a problem with fuel leaking badly from under the reservoir cap. Sometimes I need to turn the tool 90 degrees to edge the grass, and this causes the fuel to start leaking. The leak is not small, it will empty the reservoir in just few seconds. Considering that the unit gets hot almost immediately after it starts, this leak can easily cause it to catch fire. Unfortunately, the part list is nowhere to be found. There is a phony link on the HD page reading "Replacement Part List", but the link opens a PDF file which has only one page, instructing to send email to customer support. I need to find a way to buy the new reservoir or the cap, but it is not possible to be sure that the replacement will work without knowing the part number. I wish that the manufacturer of this trimmer had a more reliable cap to close the reservoir so it does not leak. After all, I used the tool very few times, and it already has this nasty problem.
Results.Title: Leaks fuel from the reservoir

309475184.Description: The Wild Badger Power Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. This tool includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. The full crank engine reduces emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by a vented aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The attachment capable straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube and connection point which is lightweight and durable. The tap-and-go trimmer head with easy load allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
